info.title: azurepolicydocs
info.description: Command-line tool that generates Markdown documentation for Azure Policy definitions and policy set definitions from their JSON, using built-in or custom Scriban templates. Install with: dotnet tool install --global AzurePolicyDocs.Cli

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generates Markdown documentation for Azure Policy definitions and policy set definitions from their JSON.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generates a Markdown document for each policy definition or policy set definition.

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Generates documentation for every file matching the glob, for example "Definitions/**/*.json". Cannot be combined with an input file.

options.name: --outdir
options.description: Writes generated files beneath this directory. With --pattern, the directory structure under the pattern root is preserved.

options.name: --outfile
options.description: Writes the generated document to this exact path. Single input only.

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Prints the generated document to stdout and writes no file. Single input only. [default: False]

options.name: --template
options.description: Path to a custom Scriban template. Defaults to the built-in Markdown template.

options.name: --include-root
options.description: Directory that Scriban include paths resolve against. Defaults to the directory of the input file (generate) or of the output file (catalog).

options.name: --custom-template-value
options.description: Supplies a custom template value as key=value, available to templates as custom.<key>. May be repeated.

options.name: --custom-template-value-file-path
options.description: Loads custom template values from a JSON object whose values are strings. May be repeated.

arguments.name: INPUTFILE
arguments.description: Path to a policy definition or policy set definition file (.json or .jsonc).

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Generates one Markdown index of all policies matching a glob pattern.

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Glob that selects the policy files to list, for example "Definitions/**/*.json".

options.name: --outfile
options.description: Where to write the catalog. Defaults to README.md in the pattern root.

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Prints the catalog to stdout and writes no file. [default: False]

options.name: --docs-dir
options.description: Directory where 'generate --outdir' wrote the per-policy documents; catalog links point there. Defaults to linking a .md file beside each source file.

options.name: --template
options.description: Path to a custom Scriban template. Defaults to the built-in Markdown template.

options.name: --include-root
options.description: Directory that Scriban include paths resolve against. Defaults to the directory of the input file (generate) or of the output file (catalog).

options.name: --custom-template-value
options.description: Supplies a custom template value as key=value, available to templates as custom.<key>. May be repeated.

options.name: --custom-template-value-file-path
options.description: Loads custom template values from a JSON object whose values are strings. May be repeated.

commands.name: template
commands.description: Works with the built-in Scriban templates.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Prints a built-in template so you can copy and adapt it.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Which template to export: policyDefinition, policySetDefinition, catalog.

options.name: --outfile
options.description: Writes the template to this path instead of stdout.
